historical_record.description: The Art Commission approved the Phase 3 drawings for District Health Center No. 3, the Bayview Health Center at Barneveld and Silver Avenues, by Hertzka and Knowles.

The Art Commission approved David Arnold to design and make stained-glass windows for the Bayview Health Center at Barneveld and Silver Avenues, for $4,550; the minutes give the architects as Hertzka and Knowles.
